items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted off; Tyson Bagent has replaced him vs Vikings.
items.why: Hamstring on play, replaced by Bagent
items.implication: Bagent now QB; impacts CHI pass catchers volume/efficiency rest of game and potentially ROS
items.opportunity: Check Bagent usage; Swift/Odunze etc still relevant but QB downgrade

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. If ignored preseason, grab Jonah Coleman now.
items.implication: McConkey playable; Coleman immediate add for DEN RB upside

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today vs Raiders after cracked rib; will wear flak jacket. Official confirmation after GTD optimism.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR, Rapoport bullish tone
items.implication: Start with injury docks; primary WR target remains viable
items.opportunity: Full routes expected but limited physicality possible

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today vs Jaguars due to hamstring. Confirmed after unlikely/not expected reports.
items.implication: Elevates handcuff/backup looks in DEN backfield
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return vs Titans after going to locker room.
items.implication: Monitor return; if out elevates Gainwell/handcuffs for remaining snaps
items.opportunity: Potential RB committee or backup surge if sits

items.text: Packers have ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck) vs Jets.
items.implication: Elevates Christian Watson, Wicks, Kraft targets

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT with hamstring for Week 2 vs Bengals; confirmed inactives.
items.implication: Target vacuum for HOU pass catchers including Schultz

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow officially active and will start vs Texans despite back discomfort listed as questionable.
items.why: Cleared after limited practice week; Rapoport confirmed will play
items.implication: QB1 start; full offense with Chase/Higgins expected
items.opportunity: Normal snap share and red-zone looks

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave active and expected to play vs Ravens after hamstring; clean bill per analysts.
items.why: Expected to play, no real docks
items.implication: WR1 start for NO; high target volume
items.opportunity: Full routes, no snap limit reported

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers inactive/OUT vs Chargers after doubtful knee listing; could return next week.
items.why: Knee (meniscus), returned to practice but out
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated for TE snaps/targets

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late. Puka true GTD. Olave clean no docks.
items.why: Bullish reports + practice improvement for McConkey; Olave fine; Nacua uncertain
items.implication: McConkey startable with caution; Olave full go; fade Nacua until confirmed
items.opportunity: McConkey routes with flak; Olave full share

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers officially OUT with hamstring injury for Week 2 vs Saints.
items.implication: Opens targets for Bateman and others in BAL WR room
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining WRs/TEs

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. OUT with foot injury vs Patriots; confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Elevates DK Metcalf and slot/ rookie looks like Germie Bernard
items.opportunity: More targets for Metcalf, Warren, Bernard

items.text: Sunday AM summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak, Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow/McMillan expected (snap count), Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Core status board for lineup locks; many confirmed later

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is true game-time decision / pregame for MNF vs Giants; trending wrong way toward missing per Schefter.
items.why: Hip injury, limited/no practice late week
items.implication: If out, Davante Adams sees massive target bump; monitor warmups

items.text: Tua Tagovailoa inactive for Falcons (with Penix also out); Cooper Rush expected to start.
items.implication: ATL QB downgrade impacts London/Bijan receiving
items.opportunity: Rush volume to Drake London etc.

items.text: Agrees with stash of Germie Bernard (Pittman out); good fit with McCarthy offense, YAC man. Also Elijah Sarratt for BAL depth.
items.implication: Deep league stash/add for PIT WR3 upside

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey doubtful/out. Decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman out. Projections updating.
items.why: Teammate absences open roles for backups/rookies
items.implication: Stash/stream Coleman (DEN) and Bernard (PIT) in deeper formats
